column1: # Pipedpeer lab campaign experiment matrix (brief S9; cases in
# docs/benchmarks/campaign-cases.md). Tab separated, one row per
# (workload set, systems, sizes) slice:
#   experiment workload systems sizes repeats warmup timeout_s size_mode
# systems: plain pipedpeer pipedpeer-headcount pipedpeer-noshim ray dask ssh
#          pipedpeer-exact pipedpeer-fast torchrun
# sizes: comma list of N, or `scaling` = 1,2,4,8,16,24,32; plain runs only at
#        n=1 (a higher N needs a cluster to split a run across). E8's sizes are
#        the DDP ranks / node counts. Slices of E8 keep per-system sizes, so
#        E8 has one row per system subset.
# warmup: warm-up runs (r0) per (workload, system, N) before the shuffled repeats.
# timeout_s: lab_wait timeout for one run (ASSUMED: none of the steps pin
#        these numbers; they are deliberately generous, ~10x a measured run).
# E8's repeats are the seeds: 11,12,13 = BENCH_SEED = 10 + repeat (run.sh sets it).
